exposure: perineural administration of dexamethasone as an adjunct to lidocaine with adrenaline
cohort: Adult patients undergoing ambulatory elective hand, wrist, or forearm surgeries requiring an axillary brachial plexus block.
finding: The addition of dexamethasone to lidocaine with adrenaline prolonged the duration of sensory blockade and the time to first analgesic request, but it did not reduce the onset time of sensory block.
